about: One sound track per emote (user 2026-11-11: "8 gym emotes" on a wheel; standing rule: any audio Claude makes is made with ElevenLabs and lined up with its animation). Each emote (art/scripts/emote_animations.py) gets one ElevenLabs Sound Effects take from its own prompt (its moves in order, no voice, as the user asked for celebrations), then art/scripts/make_celebration_tracks.py (TRACKS_MANIFEST=this file, TRACKS_ROOT=D:/Powerlifting Roblox Extras/Sounds/Emotes) puts its hits on their cues. Uploaded; ids in EmoteConfig. Audio files stay outside the repo. Chalk Clap and the Trap Slap's last clap were assembled from takes' own claps by art/scripts/compose_emote_claps.py (the takes would not give every clap).
license: ElevenLabs generated; the account is on a paid plan (user, 2026-11-05)
settings: ElevenLabs Sound Effects v2 (eleven_text_to_sound_v2), duration_seconds = the emote's length, prompt_influence 0.7, two takes each, the better picked by make_celebration_tracks.py

Wave.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A person in a gym raises one arm and waves. At 0.35 seconds a soft quick arm whoosh and a light fabric swish, then four gentle swishes of a waving hand, then the arm drops with a soft swish. Quiet, close and natural, 2.4 seconds

ChalkClap.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A powerlifter in a gym. At 0.35 seconds one crisp, loud, chalky hand clap with a puff of powder. At 0.65 seconds a second crisp chalky clap. Then a soft, dry rubbing of chalky palms together, then quiet. Close and natural, 2 seconds

BeltTighten.prompt: Powerlifting sound effects only, no voice, no music. A powerlifter in a powerlifting gym adjusts his thick lever powerlifting belt. 0.7 seconds: one sharp, crisp SNAP of the belt flicked tight, like a whip crack on leather. 1.1 seconds: a second sharp belt SNAP. 1.7 seconds: a quick flick of the belt lever clicking shut. Then quiet. 2.6 seconds

DoubleBiceps.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A bodybuilder in a gym. At 0.45 seconds both arms snap up into a flex: a quick double arm whoosh and a tight fabric stretch. Then a faint trembling fabric strain held for almost two seconds. Then the arms drop with a soft swish. Close and natural, 3 seconds

TrapSlap.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A powerlifter in a gym. At 0.4 seconds both hands slap hard on top of the shoulders: a meaty double slap. At 0.7 seconds the same shoulder slap again. At 1.15 seconds one loud, sharp, chalky hand clap. Then a strong arm whoosh as the arms swing out, then quiet. Close and natural, 2.6 seconds

PointLaugh.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no laughter, no breathing, no music. A person in a gym. At 0.45 seconds one sharp, quick arm whoosh and a fabric snap as an arm points forward. Then a few soft, light pats of a hand on a stomach over a T-shirt, then quiet. Close and natural, 3 seconds

SitBreath.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A tired powerlifter in a gym. A soft shuffle of shoes, then at 1.15 seconds a heavy body sitting down on a rubber gym floor: a dull, soft thud. Quiet for two seconds with a faint fabric rustle. At about 3.8 seconds shoes scuff on the floor and a fabric rustle as he stands back up. Close and natural, 5 seconds

MostMuscular.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A bodybuilder in a gym. At 0.5 seconds he crunches into a most muscular pose: a quick whoosh, a tight fabric strain and a shoe scuff on the floor. Then a trembling, straining fabric stretch held for almost two seconds. Then a relaxing swish. Close and natural, 3.2 seconds
